description: This file defines the AuthService class responsible for handling authentication operations such as sign-in, sign-up (with retry logic), sign-out, retrieving the current user, and fetching user role data. It interacts with the Supabase client for backend authentication and user management.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: A class providing authentication methods such as sign-in, sign-up with retries, sign-out, current user retrieval, and role fetching, built around the Supabase client.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Signs in a user with email and password.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, with retry logic for handling transient errors, and redirects based on environment variable.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the current authenticated user.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Getter for retrieving the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: currentRole
methods.description: Retrieves the role of the current user from user metadata, defaulting to 'patient'.

methods.name: fetchRoleFromProfiles
methods.description: Fetches the user's role from the profiles table based on user ID.

methods.name: buildAppUser
methods.description: Constructs an AppUser object from the current user, attempting to resolve the role from profile data.
